approval_note: 用户明确批准平衡档：60秒/1024周期，Java相对倍率16；性能优化主线优先推进去jree化与TypeScript原生运行逻辑。
purpose: 在功能等价先决条件成立后，为单线程 TypeScript 性能验收提供可审阅的绝对预算、相对 Java 预算和 stall 定义；不自动改变当前 runner 的通过结论。

baseline.comparison_mode: cold-process wall time; warm-up and official repetitions must be recorded separately

equivalence_gate.marker_samples: all Java markers must be matched by TypeScript at the corresponding logical marker
equivalence_gate.markerless_samples: 131072 cycles with the defined internal stage digest remains the alternate equivalence route

measurement_contract.normalization: ts_wall_ms / reasoning_cycles * 1024; only completed, functional, non-stalled observations qualify

fast_and_medium_sampling.p95_policy: omit p95 below 20 official repetitions; report median and min/max range

high_cost_sampling.p95_policy: do not report p95; report every raw value, median and range

stall.definition: no progress event, cycle checkpoint, marker or digest update
stall.classification: error; ordinary slowness is not a functional failure

process_limit.definition: independent host safety ceiling, not a performance pass/fail result
process_limit.required_record: process_limited, last_progress_cycle, elapsed_ms and whether the sample had functional evidence

measurement_contract.rss: TypeScript peak RSS is reportable; Java Windows RSS is unavailable in the current adapter and must remain explicitly incomparable

scenarios.label: 保守
scenarios.interpretation: 优先保证持续可用和不把正常慢运行误判为卡死；不代表性能等价

scenarios.label: 平衡
scenarios.interpretation: 保留较宽绝对安全余量，同时要求 TypeScript 不长期超过 Java 一个数量级以上的宽松边界

scenarios.label: 激进
scenarios.interpretation: 把性能差距纳入发布质量门槛；需要继续 profile 和优化，不能用当前证据直接承诺

current_observations.qualification: exploratory_only; current repeated evidence is mostly 2 official runs and does not establish stable median/p95

samples.qualification_note: one official run; repeat before any contract decision

decision_rule: 用户批准一个 scenario 后，P2 才能按该 scenario 取得合格重复基线；在批准前所有 scenario 都是 proposed，不能用于标记 LeanSpec 020 complete。
